# Exact compiled declaration templates, grouped by the named patch that needs them.
# Readers select requested patch names plus named dependencies. Nothing else may change.
# JSON uses canonical attribute and child order. Duplicate declarations remain significant.
#
# Settings adds an exported alias for Android's App info page. Its target and filter are fixed.
[HushTumblr settings]
exported-added activity-alias:app.hushtumblr.extension.tumblr.settings.OpenSettings
component-added {"tag":"activity-alias","attributes":{"android:exported":"true","android:name":"app.hushtumblr.extension.tumblr.settings.OpenSettings","android:targetActivity":"com.tumblr.ui.activity.JumpoffActivity"},"children":[]}
filter-added {"owner":"activity-alias:app.hushtumblr.extension.tumblr.settings.OpenSettings","declaration":{"tag":"intent-filter","attributes":{},"children":[{"tag":"action","attributes":{"android:name":"android.intent.action.APPLICATION_PREFERENCES"},"children":[]},{"tag":"category","attributes":{"android:name":"android.intent.category.DEFAULT"},"children":[]}]}}

# Only these application metadata entries change: Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance
# collection, Google Analytics' ad ID collection, and Google's four default consent signals. Each
# is added, or an existing entry keeps its other attributes and children, gets the value shown,
# and loses android:resource.
# FCM, Firebase Installations, auth declarations and all other metadata stay exactly as compiled.
[Disable analytics]
metadata-added {"owner":"application","declaration":{"tag":"meta-data","attributes":{"android:name":"firebase_analytics_collection_deactivated","android:value":"true"},"children":[]}}
metadata-added {"owner":"application","declaration":{"tag":"meta-data","attributes":{"android:name":"firebase_crashlytics_collection_enabled","android:value":"false"},"children":[]}}
metadata-added {"owner":"application","declaration":{"tag":"meta-data","attributes":{"android:name":"firebase_performance_collection_deactivated","android:value":"true"},"children":[]}}
metadata-added {"owner":"application","declaration":{"tag":"meta-data","attributes":{"android:name":"google_analytics_adid_collection_enabled","android:value":"false"},"children":[]}}
metadata-added {"owner":"application","declaration":{"tag":"meta-data","attributes":{"android:name":"google_analytics_default_allow_analytics_storage","android:value":"false"},"children":[]}}
metadata-added {"owner":"application","declaration":{"tag":"meta-data","attributes":{"android:name":"google_analytics_default_allow_ad_storage","android:value":"false"},"children":[]}}
metadata-added {"owner":"application","declaration":{"tag":"meta-data","attributes":{"android:name":"google_analytics_default_allow_ad_user_data","android:value":"false"},"children":[]}}
metadata-added {"owner":"application","declaration":{"tag":"meta-data","attributes":{"android:name":"google_analytics_default_allow_ad_personalization_signals","android:value":"false"},"children":[]}}

# Google's advertising ID permission and the Privacy Sandbox ad services permissions are dropped,
# and the application loses only its android.adservices.AD_SERVICES_CONFIG property. The
# application's compiled declaration differs between builds, so the property is approved by name:
# its removal changes that one application declaration and nothing else, other properties included.
[Remove ad tracking permissions]
permission-removed com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID
permission-removed android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_ID
permission-removed android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_ATTRIBUTION
permission-removed android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_TOPICS
component-removed {"owner":"application","declaration":{"tag":"property","attributes":{"android:name":"android.adservices.AD_SERVICES_CONFIG"},"children":[]}}

# Two application metadata entries are added, naming Tumblr's own signing certificate for
# signature spoofing: its SHA-1 for microG-RE and the whole DER certificate in hex for modules such
# as XSpoofSignatures. No permission is added or requested, FAKE_PACKAGE_SIGNATURE included.
[Spoof signature for Google sign-in]
metadata-added {"owner":"application","declaration":{"tag":"meta-data","attributes":{"android:name":"app.revanced.android.gms.SPOOFED_PACKAGE_SIGNATURE","android:value":"cd177dd4057daf3af7eca430825ee7dc08ad56fa"},"children":[]}}
metadata-added {"owner":"application","declaration":{"tag":"meta-data","attributes":{"android:name":"fake-signature","android:value":""},"children":[]}}
